ai_review.summary: Decent audience‑sourced recording captures a solid set with standout Black Peter and the long, slower Aiko, plus Bob’s lively scats.
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience capture that carries noticeable crowd noise in the first set but clears up later, delivering overall acceptable sound quality. Musically the show shines with a powerful Black Peter rendition, a lengthy Aiko that fans were eager to hear, and Bob Weir in good form adding scats and ad‑libs. While not flawless, the performance feels energetic and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: One review with a 4‑star rating points to a good musical show (≈4) but only decent recording quality (≈3.5); weighted average yields ~3.9.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd noise prominent in the first set, less so later; overall sound is acceptable with no major defects noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows strong early momentum despite crowd bleed, settles into a smoother second half.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby was in good form on this summer tour with scats and ad‑libs.
